name: IMDb & Radarr / Sonarr
author: OmniDesk
description: IMDb/TMDB charts & metadata discovery, media.local_match.v1 check, and fail-closed dry-run-safe Radarr/Sonarr queue management.

config_schema.label: IMDb API Base URL
config_schema.description: User-configured IMDb-compatible JSON API base URL (http/https only)

config_schema.label: TMDB API Base URL（可选）
config_schema.description: Optional user-configured TMDB v3 compatible base URL (http/https only)

config_schema.label: 榜单数据源协议
config_schema.description: API path convention for charts/search/detail endpoints

config_schema.label: IMDb API Key（可选）
config_schema.description: Stored exclusively in 0600 SecretVault (never written to plain config or logs)

config_schema.label: TMDB API Key（可选）
config_schema.description: Stored exclusively in 0600 SecretVault (never written to plain config or logs)

config_schema.label: Radarr Base URL
config_schema.description: Explicitly configured Radarr base URL (e.g. LAN http://...; trust_env=False)

config_schema.label: Sonarr Base URL
config_schema.description: Explicitly configured Sonarr base URL (e.g. LAN http://...; trust_env=False)

config_schema.label: 默认清晰度配置（Quality Profile）
config_schema.description: Radarr/Sonarr quality profile name or numeric ID

config_schema.label: 默认入库根目录（可选）
config_schema.description: Optional Radarr/Sonarr root folder path (resolved from server if omitted)

config_schema.label: 默认启用 Dry-Run 演练门禁
config_schema.description: Never submit downloads unless explicitly confirmed with confirm=true

config_schema.label: 请求超时（秒）
config_schema.description: HTTP timeout in seconds for IMDb/TMDB/Radarr/Sonarr requests
